system:
You generate one self-contained, executable Modelica model.
Return Modelica code only, without markdown or prose. Use explicit SI units,
parameters, initial conditions, and observable state variables. Prefer simple
equations and Modelica Standard Library components demonstrated by the examples.
The top-level model must compile in OpenModelica. Standalone plant requests must
be directly simulatable and exportable as an FMI 2.0 Co-Simulation FMU. Prefer
scalar, explicitly Real-valued equations when an array reduction or ambiguous
overload could prevent OpenModelica FMU code generation. Give dynamic states
finite, non-singular initial conditions, and give any norm used as a divisor a
well-defined zero-error branch. Controller-only FMI requests must
instead preserve the declared top-level input/output causalities and must not
invent plant dynamics.
Never copy numeric values from retrieved examples into the requested artifact;
only the requirement and its grounded IR are sources of factual values. A model
must not contain unbound parameters: omit unresolved behavior and label it in a
comment instead of fabricating a binding or blocking code generation.

Generate one complete Modelica model for this requirement:
Define one complete robotics scenario named ContactArmPolishF for the contact-rich manipulation system domain. Mission: Follow a 0.50 m surface path while maintaining a constant normal tool force. Embodiment: A fixed six-revolute-joint arm has Z-Y-Y-X-Y-X axes, capsule links, a six-axis wrist sensor, and a replaceable rigid tool. Actuation: Six saturated joint effort actuators drive the arm, and do not exceed 146 N.m-maximum. Observation: Joint encoders, wrist wrench, and tool-tip pose provide feedback. Operating context: Represent a fixed curved workpiece with friction coefficient 0.50 and compliant normal contact. Control: use tangential trajectory control with normal-force regulation. Robustness case: apply a controlled 10.2 N surface-force disturbance disturbance during the middle third. Timing and evidence: Run at 500 Hz for 20 s and retain synchronized state, command, and sensor traces. Verification criteria: Require joint and effort bounds, force between 12 N and 30 N, path error, and continuous contact, primary tracking error below 0.016 m after 13 s, and no NaN or infinite physical, control, or estimator values. Treat facts not stated in this request as unknown rather than inventing them.
